maya-okafor.name: Maya Okafor
maya-okafor.headline: General Partner at Tidewell Ventures · Pre-seed AI infrastructure · 2x founder
maya-okafor.openText: Pre-seed and seed · AI infrastructure, inference, developer and data tooling · $500K–$2M first checks · Europe and North America
maya-okafor.about:
I back technical founders building the infrastructure layer of AI: inference, orchestration, evaluation and data tooling. Before Tidewell I founded two developer-tools companies, one of which was acquired in 2022.

My agent reads everything first. A structured intent with a real metric reaches me faster than a warm intro without one, and every decline comes with a reason.

tidewell.tagline: Pre-seed and seed investors in AI infrastructure.
tidewell.about:
Tidewell Ventures writes first checks of $500K to $2M into technical teams building the infrastructure layer of AI. Fund I: 21 companies. Fund II is being raised in 2026.

Every inbound to Tidewell goes to our company agent first. It routes founder pitches to the investment team, LP inquiries to the partners, press to communications and vendors through a gate.
